body: pix2tex: Using a ViT to convert images of equations into LaTeX code.
plain_description: Turn screenshots of math equations into LaTeX code instantly — no more manual equation typing. Researchers, students, and technical writers save hours by snapping a picture or screenshot and getting accurate LaTeX output. The tool works from your clipboard, files, or a simple desktop GUI.
technical_description: pix2tex is a Python-based OCR system that converts images of mathematical equations into LaTeX code. It uses a Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder with a ResNet backbone paired with a Transformer decoder to generate token sequences. The package provides multiple interfaces: a CLI tool, a GUI application (latexocr) for screenshot-based capture, a Python API, and a Streamlit web demo. Docker images are available for containerized deployment. Pre-trained model checkpoints are downloaded automatically. Training is supported via a custom dataset pipeline using XeLaTeX-rendered images and a configurable tokenizer.
title: LaTeX OCR
